title: manim-lint baseline v1
description: Known-diagnostic fingerprints (DESIGN 8.3). A fingerprint never contains line numbers: it is rule ID + relative path + qualified Scene name + surrounding token hash, so inserting unrelated lines elsewhere in a file does not invalidate entries. Entries are sorted and each entry hides at most one matching diagnostic. Compatibility: an entry whose scene is the empty string matches a diagnostic regardless of its computed scene (baselines written before scene attribution store "" everywhere); a non-empty scene only matches that scene.

path.description: Project-relative POSIX path of the diagnosed file

scene.description: Qualified name of the discovered Scene class enclosing the diagnostic, or "" outside every Scene. When stored, "" additionally matches any computed scene (wildcard for pre-attribution baselines)

token_hash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the token kinds and texts of the diagnostic statement line and its nearest non-blank neighbor lines
